summary: MediWound Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 annual general meeting of shareholders held on May 6, 2026. Shareholders voted on routine proposals, including re-election of five directors, reappointment of KPMG as independent auditor, and approval of CEO annual cash bonus, all receiving overwhelming support (99.0% or higher). Quorum was 48.3% of outstanding ordinary shares. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management departure occurred. This is a routine disclosure of shareholder meeting outcomes with no material corporate action triggering a special-situation classification.
